name: mods
description: Function-hook mods for the Claude Code harness: a git write gate that asks the person, not the model; a status band with the location, model, context and the branch's PR; a /pr pane with buttons into the PR skills; a guard that refuses credentials in tracked files; the reply-style rule as a system-prompt section; and a /skill-tally of which skills actually fire. Each one has a switch in /config.

gitGate.title: Git write gate
gitGate.description: Ask the person before git commit, git push, gh pr create and gh pr merge run

statusBand.title: Status band
statusBand.description: Show the location, branch, model, context use and the branch's PR above the prompt

prPane.title: PR pane
prPane.description: Add /pr, a pane with the branch's PR checks, open review threads and the PR skills

ruleGuard.title: Rule guard
ruleGuard.description: Refuse edits that put a credential in a tracked file, or a blocked term in a marketplace repository

blockedTerms.title: Blocked terms
blockedTerms.description: Comma-separated terms, such as employer names, that the rule guard refuses in files of a repository with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json

replyStyle.title: Reply style
replyStyle.description: Add the Simplified Technical English reply rule to the system prompt

skillTally.title: Skill tally
skillTally.description: Count each skill that loads, across sessions, and show the counts with /skill-tally
